# Fourier Keyboard Preview

An independent, developer-signed preview of the VocaPhone keyboard, modified on November 22, 2026. VocaHQ develops VocaPhone. This contributor build is for testing the Fourier catalog entry that VocaHQ merged in 6f1f5cd21159ac90a0190aa2b507e3deca837c97. VocaHQ did not sign or publish this preview. Upstream retains all copyrights and marks.

The app and changes are offered under GNU AGPL-3.0 (see LICENSE). The preview changes the Android package identifier, launcher and keyboard labels, and icon. Usage telemetry is disabled. The full-flavor model catalog, native recognizer and downloads are upstream code. Model weights download on request from oruk/oruk-fourier-2b and carry separate terms.

Corresponding source and build instructions: https://github.com/Nathan-Roll1/vocaphone/tree/qa/fourier-android-preview-build
Original: https://github.com/VocaHQ/vocaphone/tree/6f1f5cd21159ac90a0190aa2b507e3deca837c97
The separate 'notices' directory includes the VocaPhone license, bundled keyboard dictionary notice, native software licenses and notices. Android/AndroidX and Kotlin components retain their respective license notices. The upstream native provenance and native rebuild instructions are included.
